_comment: Search space REDUCED 2026-08-12 from 29 to 13 tunables to cut overfitting: best configs carry only ~50-150 trades, so ~29 free parameters was roughly 3-5 observations per parameter. Dropped params are pinned in base_params.json at the user's live chart values. G4 is pinned OFF because it is the one component the TradingView parity check proved disagrees with the Pine script. SUPERTREND OPENED 2026-08-16: useG1/g1_mult/useS4/s4_mult/useS5 added. Three of the nine active filters are Supertrend-based and every one of their settings had been frozen at 10/3.0 since the system was built, so the GA was tuning around them. ATR periods stay pinned; only the multipliers vary.

objective._comment: score = net_pct - dd_weight*|dd_pct| - overtrade_penalty*max(0, trades-overtrade_cap). REVISED 2026-08-11 after the 618K-eval analysis: the old dd_weight=1.0 / min_trades=1 objective was filling the board with 8-19 trade flukes (DEXE +2634% on 10 trades, PF 73). dd_weight 2.5 makes a config earn 2.5 points of profit per point of drawdown; min_trades 50 kills thin samples (15m median is 9 trades, p99 is 49). `trades` counts distinct ENTRIES, not exit legs, so the gate cannot be cleared by enabling partial TPs. No overtrade penalty: more trades is wanted.

parameters._c: ATR length (risk). Drives the stop buffer and every ATR proximity test.
parameters.name: atrLenRisk

parameters._c: 6E volume filter: min volume x SMA.
parameters.name: volMultMin

parameters._c: 12 S6 max distance to level (ATR mult). MEASURED as the strongest trade-count lever that generalises across all 19 coins.
parameters.name: s6_prox

parameters._c: 12 S6 detection length. Pine input bounds 3-13.
parameters.name: s6_len

parameters._c: 9B R:R SL buffer below the swing low (x ATR). Measured stronger than the minSlDistAtr floor, which is now pinned.
parameters.name: rrBufAtr

parameters._c: Exit mgmt: partial TPs on/off. Negative on the 19-coin average but positive per coin, so searched not forced.
parameters.name: rrUsePartialTp

parameters._c: Exit mgmt: % trailing stop on/off. Same caveat as partials.
parameters.name: rrUseTrailSl

parameters._c: 3 G1 Supertrend regime on/off. Was pinned true and never tested — the GA has never been able to ask whether this filter earns its keep (compare useG3, which it switches off in the current best ZEC config).
parameters.name: useG1

parameters._c: 3 G1 Supertrend ATR multiplier. Controls how often the trend flips, which gates how many bars are eligible for entry — normally one of the highest-impact settings in any Supertrend strategy. ATR period stays pinned at 10 (second-order).
parameters.name: g1_mult

parameters._c: 10 S4 Supertrend structure on/off. Was pinned true.
parameters.name: useS4

parameters._c: 10 S4 Supertrend ATR multiplier. ATR period stays pinned at 10.
parameters.name: s4_mult

parameters._c: 11 S5 Pivot Point Supertrend on/off. Was pinned true. Its pivot period / factor / ATR period stay pinned.
parameters.name: useS5
